Title: Apply SAVE10 to ₹1000 subtotal
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹1000 and SAVE10 is active
Expected Result: Discount of ₹100 is applied to item subtotal and order total updates.

Title: Apply FLAT200 to ₹1500 subtotal
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹1500 and FLAT200 is active
Expected Result: Discount of ₹200 is applied and total updates.

Title: Reject FLAT200 below minimum
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹800
Expected Result: Message "This code requires a minimum order of ₹1000." is shown and total is unchanged.

Title: Accept FLAT200 exactly at minimum
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is exactly ₹1000
Expected Result: Code is accepted and ₹200 discount is applied.

Title: Reject FLAT200 just below minimum
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹999
Expected Result: Minimum-order error is shown and total is unchanged.

Title: Expired code is rejected
Preconditions: Promo code EXPIRED10 exists but validity window has ended
Expected Result: Message "This code has expired." is shown and total is unchanged.

Title: Non-existent code is rejected
Preconditions: Cart is on checkout page
Expected Result: Message "Invalid promo code." is shown and total is unchanged.

Title: Lowercase save10 behaves like SAVE10
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹1000 and SAVE10 is active
Expected Result: Discount of ₹100 is applied identically to SAVE10.

Title: Mixed-case Save10 behaves like SAVE10
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹1000 and SAVE10 is active
Expected Result: Discount of ₹100 is applied identically to SAVE10.

Title: Already redeemed single-use code is rejected
Preconditions: Customer has previously redeemed ONCE100
Expected Result: Message "This code has already been used." is shown and total is unchanged.

Title: Fixed discount is capped at subtotal
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹150 and FLAT200 variant has no minimum
Expected Result: Discounted subtotal becomes ₹0 and never negative.

Title: Fixed discount equal to subtotal results in zero subtotal
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹200 and fixed discount is ₹200
Expected Result: Discounted subtotal is exactly ₹0.

Title: Confirm replacing existing code applies only new code
Preconditions: SAVE10 already applied to cart
Steps: 1. Enter FLAT200; 2. Click Apply; 3. Confirm replacement
Expected Result: SAVE10 is removed and only FLAT200 discount applies.

Title: Cancel replacing existing code keeps old code
Preconditions: SAVE10 already applied to cart
Steps: 1. Enter FLAT200; 2. Click Apply; 3. Cancel replacement prompt
Expected Result: SAVE10 remains applied and FLAT200 is not applied.

Title: Empty promo input is rejected
Preconditions: Checkout page is open
Steps: 1. Leave promo input blank; 2. Click Apply
Expected Result: Message "Enter a promo code." is shown.

Title: Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹1000 and SAVE10 is active
Steps: 1. Enter code with spaces; 2. Click Apply
Expected Result: Spaces are trimmed and SAVE10 discount is applied.

Title: Trim spaces and normalize lowercase code
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹1000 and SAVE10 is active
Steps: 1. Enter lowercase code with spaces; 2. Click Apply
Expected Result: Code is trimmed, matched case-insensitively, and ₹100 discount is applied.

Title: Applied minimum code removed when subtotal drops below minimum
Preconditions: FLAT200 is applied to cart subtotal ₹1500
Expected Result: Promo is revalidated, discount is removed, and code is no longer eligible.

Title: Applied minimum code remains when subtotal stays eligible
Preconditions: FLAT200 is applied to cart subtotal ₹1500
Expected Result: Promo remains applied and total recalculates with ₹200 discount.

Title: Percentage discount on small subtotal rounds consistently
Preconditions: SAVE10 active and cart subtotal is ₹99
Expected Result: 10% subtotal discount is calculated using application rounding rules and total updates.

Title: Percentage discount applies to subtotal only, not shipping
Preconditions: Cart has subtotal ₹1000 and shipping charge exists
Expected Result: Discount is ₹100 on subtotal only; shipping is not discounted.

Title: Taxes calculated on discounted subtotal
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹1000 with tax calculation enabled
Steps: 1. Enter SAVE10; 2. Click Apply; 3. Review tax amount
Expected Result: Tax is calculated on ₹900 discounted subtotal, not ₹1000.

Title: Fixed discount affects taxable subtotal
Preconditions: Cart subtotal is ₹1500 with tax calculation enabled
Steps: 1. Enter FLAT200; 2. Click Apply; 3. Review tax amount
Expected Result: Tax is calculated on ₹1300 discounted subtotal.

Title: Code valid at start of validity window is accepted
Preconditions: Current time equals code validity start
Steps: 1. Enter windowed active code; 2. Click Apply
Expected Result: Code is accepted if usage and cart rules are satisfied.

Title: Code rejected after validity end
Preconditions: Current time is after code validity end
Expected Result: Expired-code message is shown and total is unchanged.

Title: Whitespace-only input is treated as empty
Preconditions: Checkout page is open
Expected Result: After trimming, message "Enter a promo code." is shown.

Title: Second invalid code does not replace existing valid code
Preconditions: SAVE10 already applied
Steps: 1. Enter invalid second code; 2. Click Apply
Expected Result: Invalid promo code message is shown and SAVE10 remains applied.

Title: Second ineligible code does not replace existing code
Preconditions: SAVE10 already applied and subtotal is ₹800
Expected Result: Minimum-order error is shown and existing SAVE10 remains applied unless valid replacement is confirmed.

Title: Already-used replacement code is rejected
Preconditions: SAVE10 already applied; ONCE100 was redeemed earlier
Expected Result: Already-used message is shown and existing code remains unchanged.

Title: Promo discount recalculates when subtotal increases
Preconditions: SAVE10 applied to subtotal ₹1000
Expected Result: Discount recalculates from ₹100 to ₹200 and total updates.

Title: Capped fixed discount recalculates after cart change
Preconditions: Fixed ₹200 no-minimum code applied to subtotal ₹150
Expected Result: Discount recalculates to ₹200 and discounted subtotal becomes ₹100.

Title: Empty input does not clear existing promo
Preconditions: SAVE10 is already applied
Expected Result: Message "Enter a promo code." is shown and existing applied discount remains unchanged.

Title: Unsupported characters in code rejected as invalid
Preconditions: Checkout page is open
Steps: 1. Enter code containing unsupported symbols; 2. Click Apply
Expected Result: Message "Invalid promo code." is shown and total is unchanged.

Title: Discounts are not stacked when replacing code
Preconditions: SAVE10 applied to ₹1500 subtotal
Steps: 1. Enter FLAT200; 2. Confirm replacement; 3. Review summary
Expected Result: Only ₹200 discount is applied; previous ₹150 SAVE10 discount is removed and not stacked.
